citations.claim: Initial velocity error is large: body moving down at ~5.85 m/s while waypoint requires motion up/right, so kp*error exceeds fmax
First violating step: controller force 250.338 exceeds limit 194.576; body velocity still far from commanded velocity

counterfactual.change: Lowered controller kp from 26.407 to 10.0 only; commanded force then stays under fmax so no controller_force_limit violation in 1 step

explanation: Controller commands approximately kp * velocity-error (plus seeded sensor noise) without clamping to fmax. At step 0 body has large velocity error (vy=-5.85 vs commanded velocity toward waypoint (12.1,8.8) at vcmd=5.39). With kp=26.4 this yields force ~250.3 > fmax 194.58 at step 1. Lowering kp alone removes the violation, confirming unclamped proportional gain as cause.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts on the left side of the empty arena far southwest of the green waypoint. From step 0 to step 1 it remains essentially stationary with no visible jump or wall interaction.
